alt: Line chart of 7-day activation by sign-up month from January 2021 to September 2025, with January sign-ups marked. Rates mostly sit between about 10% and 27% until 2025, then rise to 36.6% in September 2025.
caption: 7-day activation by sign-up month, January 2021 to September 2025. January is the highest month of each year from 2021 to 2024. September 2025, at 36.6%, is the highest month in the data but sits at the edge of the data, so the analysis does not rely on it.
